intro.welcomeText: I'm your host tonight: 12 cafés, from Rococo to Den Engel. At every café you pick a drink, play Drunken Bastard, solve the pubtask and read a fun fact. Most points wins!
intro.cardsText: At every café each player picks one of 10 face-down cards. Every card does something: hand out a sip, pick a drinking buddy, invent a rule, become Thumb King… A sip is always a sip of your own drink, and alcohol-free counts.
intro.pubtasksText: Every café has a question about the place itself. Right first time: 100 points. Second try: 80. Third try: 60. After that I'll tell you the answer, but there are no points.
intro.bonusText: Sometimes I have a bonus task for you. Send a photo or video as proof: the host approves it, and only then do the points count.
intro.respectText: Ask staff and guests before you photograph them, never get in the way at the bar, and drink at your own pace. Tradition: everyone treats the winner to a drink of their choice. Alcohol-free is fine, and nobody has to.

cards.title: Drunken Bastard
cards.yourTurn: Your turn! Pick one of 10 face-down cards.
cards.sipNote: A sip is always a sip of your own drink. Alcohol-free counts.

effects.2: Hand out a sip: choose who drinks.
effects.4: Everyone touches the floor as fast as possible. The last one drinks a sip.
effects.5: Every woman playing takes a sip.
effects.6: Every man playing takes a sip.
effects.7: Everyone points up as fast as possible. The last one drinks a sip.
effects.8: Choose a drinking buddy, also from another team. From now on, when one of you drinks, the other drinks along.
effects.9: Say a word. Going round, everyone says a word that rhymes with it. Whoever can't, or repeats a word, drinks a sip.
effects.10: Choose a category. Going round, everyone names something in it. Whoever can't, or repeats one, drinks a sip.
effects.J: Invent a rule that everyone follows for the rest of the game. At most 4 rules: a 5th replaces the oldest.
effects.Q: You're the Question Bitch until someone else draws a queen: anyone who answers a question from you drinks a sip.
effects.K: You're the Thumb King until someone else draws a king: put your thumb on the table at any moment. Everyone copies you, and the last one drinks a sip.
effects.A: You're the Beunaas until someone else draws an ace: you drink double, and so does your drinking buddy.

cards.rulePlaceholder: e.g. drink only with your left hand
